changelog: Fraud and Flash Calls no longer share Configuration's behavior selector, so switching between them cannot contaminate or activate its four settings tabs.
Public browser validation now exercises both operational submenus and requires Configuration to retain exactly Trunks, IP Directory, Alerts and Fraud.
changelog_es: Los submenús Fraud y Flash Calls ya no comparten el selector de comportamiento de Configuration; cambiar entre ellos no contamina ni activa sus cuatro pestaña
La validación pública ahora recorre ambos submenús y exige que Configuration conserve exactamente Trunks, IP Directory, Alerts y Fraud.
